name: Hamstring Curl in Straps
summary: Feet in the long loops with the legs long on a diagonal: bend the knees to pull the heels towards the seat, parallel, then press out again.
steps: Lie on the back with the long loops over the arches, legs long on a 45° line, parallel.
Breathe in to bend the knees, heels drawing towards the sit bones.
Breathe out to press out along the same line.

layers.title: Add a small bridge
layers.text: At full bend, float the pelvis a few centimetres and lower.

cautions.note: Lying flat on the back: keep it to a few minutes, raise the head end if you can, and stop if she feels dizzy.

cues:
Knees stay hip-width and parallel.
Tailbone stays down.
Feel the backs of the thighs pull, not the hip creases.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Single leg
variations.note: One strap; other leg in tabletop.
